senses.gloss: m. (κυνήγιον) same, hunt, chase, beasts of chase.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>אין הרשע … מראה ק׳ דידיה היאך וכ׳</he> the wicked man does not leave this world before God shows his chase, (that is,) how he has been caught.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:3">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>בהמות … הם ק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="S01573"><he>קניגון</he></cite>) Behemoth and Leviathan shall be the beasts of contest (the show) for the righteous in the hereafter, and whosoever abstains from witnessing the beast fights of the nations in this world, shall be admitted to see them &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161:8">Yalk. Sam. 161</cite> <cite ref="S01576"><he>קניגיון</he></cite>.
